privacy: Tikina aggregates only; no household identity, names, GPS, facility names or free text. Household-member counts suppressed in Tikina/source/day groups with fewer than five reports. Population measures are separate and must not be added.
interpretation: Non-probability assessment coverage. Do not extrapolate observed dependency or shortage rates to all Tikina residents. Community affected reports deduplicated by exact canonical community within the community-water form; unreviewed aliases may remain. Household members are a separate surveyed-household measure.
